title: Origin story: Zeus
description: Zeus was the youngest son of the Titans Cronus and Rhea. Cronus swallowed each of his children at birth to thwart a prophecy, but Rhea hid Zeus in a Cretan cave and fed Cronus a stone wrapped in swaddling clothes. Grown, Zeus forced his father to disgorge his siblings and led them in the ten-year Titanomachy, casting lots with his brothers afterward for dominion over the cosmos.

title: Cultural impact: Zeus
description: The model of divine kingship in Western literature; his thunderbolt remains the emblem of supreme power.
